correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the LCF 19-vertex, 38-edge, 4-regular graph from the actual frozen RESULT.md. The first-eligible recurrence P_S(z)=z/|S| sum_{v in S}P_{S\N[v]}(z) is valid because the earliest still-eligible arrival is uniform; finite strict subset recursion is exhaustive. Independently computed the exact probabilities 92833/1256850, 520381/628425, 913/9310 at sizes 5,6,7, mean 540823/89775 and all 19 orbit site probabilities 1919129/6032880, 31441/99225, 3157883/10054800. Exhaustive 2^19 independent dominating masks gave counts 24,111,4. The separate ordered-simplex formula is consistent: its product denominator is the suffix cumulative number of I-and-blocked outside arrivals; these integrations are exact but were not separately replayed here. Independent automorphism-orbit subgroup generators were not checked in this run, but the site-class partition itself was verified.

value.rationale: This is a motivated exact finite invariant of the canonical smallest 4-regular girth-5 graph. Distinct occupation probabilities on equal-degree sites distinguish finite geometry from regular-tree approximations; all independent domination sizes and the full jamming law enable exact benchmarks for adsorption algorithms. The finite size alone does not make the fact worthless and no thermodynamic claim is made.
